rationale: Arm is a new investor in Gimlet's Series B and one of six chip architectures (NVIDIA/AMD/Intel/Arm/Cerebras/d-Matrix) Gimlet's multi-silicon inference layer explicitly supports -- a direct commercial tie beyond the cap table.
Cognition runs its Devin coding agents on a dedicated NVIDIA GPU server cluster costing hundreds of millions of dollars annually -- direct, disclosed compute-hardware demand funded by the raise.
NextEra Energy is the direct recipient of the DOE's up-to-$1.9B loan to restart its 615MW Duane Arnold nuclear plant.
Google holds a 25-year power purchase agreement for Duane Arnold's restarted output to serve AI/cloud data-center load -- the demand anchor underwriting the DOE loan.
GlobalFoundries is the direct recipient of the $375M CHIPS Act R&D award to build a domestic quantum foundry.
Rigetti is the direct recipient of the $100M CHIPS Act quantum R&D award, paired with a ~$100M non-controlling equity stake (7.74M shares) taken by the government.
